call_id.description: The unique identifier for the current call.

ai_session_id.description: The unique identifier for the AI session.

project_id.description: The project ID associated with the call.

space_id.description: The Space ID associated with the call.

global_data.description: Global data set via the `set_global_data` action, as a key-value map.

channel_active.description: Whether the channel is currently active.

content_type.description: Type of content. The value is `text/swaig`.

app_name.description: Name of the application that originated the request.

function.description: Name of the function that was invoked.

meta_data.description:
A key-value map of call-scoped metadata, set in the SWML document, by the `set_meta_data`
action, or through the APIs when the call is created. Lives for the duration of the call.

SWMLVars.description: Variables related to the SWML document executing the call.

purpose.description: The deprecated `purpose` value declared for the function, when one was provided.

argument_desc.description: The parameter schema declared for the function, describing the arguments the agent may send.

argument.description: The argument the AI agent is providing to the function.

description:
The JSON document SignalWire POSTs to a SWAIG function's `web_hook_url` when the AI agent calls
that function. See the [tool calling guide](/docs/platform/ai/tool-calling) for the surrounding
protocol.
title: SWAIG webhook request

parsed.description: The argument parsed as JSON, when a JSON object is detected within it.

raw.description: The raw argument provided by the AI agent.

substituted.description: The argument provided by the AI agent, excluding any JSON.
